newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: MERHOLD, SABHOLD TO DELIST.
newsitem.headline: MERHOLD, SABHOLD TO DELIST.

text.p: Sabvest Ltd said on Thursday it had received court approval for its restructuring and that the listings of Sabhold Group Ltd shares, Merhold Investment Corporation Ltd shares and debentures on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange would be terminated at the close of business on Friday.
The Sabvest N shares and Sabvest debentures to be issued in terms of the restructuring would be listed on the JSE with effect from the start of business on Monday, December 9, the company said.
Sabhold announced in September that it was planning to acquire the issued shares of Sabhold group and the issued shares and debentures of Merhold in a restructuring of the group.
